# The kitchen, not the chef

## Concept being clarified

That a calm, fast business comes from systems every role can run, not from one
person moving faster than everyone else.

## The metaphor

A great restaurant kitchen on a busy night is loud, fast, and calm at the same
time. Not because the chef is quicker than everyone else, but because every
station knows its job without being told. The chef built the system, then
stepped back.

## When it lands best

Whenever the viewer is proud of how hard they personally hustle. It reframes the
hustle as a missing system.

> [!tip] The pivot phrase
> "Right now you are the chef sprinting between every station, and you are
> calling that hard work."
